notes: Tab bar is now frosted, so content dissolves under it instead of showing through — the hard line across the bottom of the screen is gone.
Scrolling stops cleanly at the top and bottom instead of bouncing the whole page.
Home-screen app: content no longer scrolls up behind the clock and battery.
Long-pressing a tab, a food row or a chip no longer pops up iOS text selection.
Each tab remembers where you were scrolled, and changing day no longer rebuilds the whole screen.
maintenanceNote: Generated by scripts/prebuild.mjs from package.json and src/release-notes.json. Bump the 4-part "version" in package.json by hand (npm version cannot parse it), edit src/release-notes.json, then npm run build.
